notes: AMENDMENT_MAJORITY_TIME defaults to 2 weeks but is operator-configurable down to a 15-minute minimum (Config.cpp:895). One operator sets it to 15 minutes; the amendment with 30/35 support activates in ~15 minutes instead of 14 days — 1344x faster — with no network-wide check that the hold was shortened.
severity_reason: AMENDMENT_MAJORITY_TIME overridden to the 15-minute minimum: fixExample enabled day 0.0237 (34 minutes) instead of day 14.0207 — the hold collapsed 14 days -> 15 minutes (1344x shorter) and end-to-end enablement was 591x faster, with no network-wide check that the hold was shortened.
title: Majority-time override: an operator can shrink the 14-day hold to 15 minutes
